name: dolphin-centrifuge
title: Dolphin Centrifuge
description: Specs, dated stock list, RCF/RPM sizing and quote requests for remanufactured Alfa Laval disc stack and decanter centrifuges from Dolphin Centrifuge, Warren, Michigan. Not affiliated with Alfa Laval.

tools.name: get_centrifuge_specs
tools.description: Published specs for a model or free-text query; capacities always with fluid and conditions.

tools.name: list_centrifuge_models
tools.description: One-line summaries, filterable by type (disc stack, decanter) and application.

tools.name: check_dolphin_stock
tools.description: Dated stock list: model, condition, in stock or built to order. No prices.

tools.name: size_centrifuge
tools.description: RCF / RPM / bowl diameter conversion with basic separation guidance.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send the user's quote request to Dolphin sales (with consent).
